<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>A simple traffic light controller with red, yellow, and green signals, and a pedestrian button.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="pass_request">Request signal for pedestrians to cross.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">Count value of the internal counter.</output>
        <output id="red">Red signal indicating the state of the traffic light.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow signal indicating the state of the traffic light.</output>
        <output id="green">Green signal indicating the state of the traffic light.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <!-- TODO: Please add your logic design here -->
    <parameter_description>
        <enum id="idle">Initial state.</enum>
        <enum id="s1_red">State 1: Red light.</enum>
        <enum id="s2_yellow">State 2: Yellow light.</enum>
        <enum id="s3_green">State 3: Green light.</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[7:0]">Internal counter for timing control.</reg>
        <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]">Current state of the traffic light controller.</reg>
        <reg id="p_red">Previous value of the red signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_yellow">Previous value of the yellow signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_green">Previous value of the green signal.</reg>
        
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    'd0: state <= 'd1;
                    'd1: state <= (cnt == 3) ? 'd3 : 'd1;
                    'd2: state <= (cnt == 3) ? 'd1 : 'd2;
                    'd3: state <= (cnt == 3) ? 'd2 : 'd3;
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Counting logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 10;
            end else if (pass_request && green) begin
                cnt <= 10;
            end else begin
                if (green == 0 && p_green == 1) begin
                    cnt <= 60;
                end else if (yellow == 0 && p_yellow == 1) begin
                    cnt <= 5;
                end else if (red == 0 && p_red == 1) begin
                    cnt <= 10;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt - 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assign outputs
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                {p_red, p_yellow, p_green} <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                {p_red, p_yellow, p_green} <= {red, yellow, green};
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic for state transitions
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    'd0: state <= 'd1;
                    'd1: state <= (cnt == 3) ? 'd3 : 'd1;
                    'd2: state <= (cnt == 3) ? 'd1 : 'd2;
                    'd3: state <= (cnt == 3) ? 'd2 : 'd3;
                endcase
            end
        end
        // Combinational logic for counting
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 10;
            end else if (pass_request && green) begin
                cnt <= 10;
            end else begin
                if (green == 0 && p_green == 1) begin
                    cnt <= 60;
                end else if (yellow == 0 && p_yellow == 1) begin
                    cnt <= 5;
                end else if (red == 0 && p_red == 1) begin
                    cnt <= 10;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt - 1;
                end
            end
        end
        // Assign outputs
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                {p_red, p_yellow, p_green} <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                {p_red, p_yellow, p_green} <= {red, yellow, green};
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
